subjects.title: ZIA Firewall Control
subjects.lead: Configuring Firewall policies requires the Firewall Filtering, NAT Control and DNS Control policies, as applicable, and each has its own rules.

subjects.title: Firewall rule actions
subjects.lead: A Firewall Filtering rule's action is one of ALLOW, BLOCK_DROP, BLOCK_RESET, BLOCK_ICMP or EVAL_NWAPP.

subjects.title: Application service groups: predefined provider groups, custom groups, first-packet matching
